title: Unicode-aware palindromes
hints: Keep only the letters and digits, lowercased, and check whether that sequence reads the same both ways. The unicode package classifies runes for every script, not only ASCII.
unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsDigit(r) picks the runes to keep, and unicode.ToLower(r) normalizes case. Collect them into a []rune, then compare r[i] with r[len(r)-1-i].
var rs []rune; for _, r := range s { if unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsDigit(r) { rs = append(rs, unicode.ToLower(r)) } }; then loop i over the first half of rs and return false on any mismatch.
